title: Setup for Opus and Godot 4.6
author: wurzelbrunft
selftext:
I experimented with a configuration that uses Opus 4.6 or 4.7 with the current version of Godot 4.6.

I asked both Opus 4.6 and 4.7:

>What is your knowledge cutoff date, and what is the most recent version of Godot you have reliable knowledge of?

The answer:

>My knowledge cutoff is early 2025.

>For Godot, I have reliable knowledge of Godot 4.3 (released August 2024) and earlier. I have some awareness of Godot 4.4 (which was in development/early release around my cutoff), but details there may be incomplete or inaccurate.

Does anyone have a similar setup? Does it cause problems? Do you use an older version of Godot like 4.3? Or do you use a different model?

comments.author: CycleMother2006
comments.body: If you are concerned about its knowledge around Godot, clone the repository and point your Opus  to the local source as well as a cloned copy of Godot docs, so that it can ground any assumptions in actual verified source data. Additionally create a Godot Engine skill to track engine updates as well as any bugs or discrepancies the model encounters during development.

replies.author: North_Ad_6538
replies.body:
that is also a good idea!

Never tried creating an own skill. Do you have good recommendations?

replies.author: CycleMother2006
replies.body: Load the 'skill creator' skill from Anthropic into your agent. Then just tell it you want to make a new skill and it will walk you through the process, asking you questions as you go.

replies.author: Jagg111
replies.body: This is the way. I've got a local copy of the Godot document and 90% and run most of my work through customer skills that have explicit instructions to check against the local copy of the documentation. Been jamming for a few weeks now and it's been working well. WAY easier to get going than Unity which requires an MCP.

comments.author: Aware-Source6313
comments.body: Let me know if you get something good going. I've had mediocre results trying Claude code with Godot. You need an updated copy of the docs or give it an mcp/skill to search updated docs for the version you use, I believe that is most important.

comments.body: Gemini 3 flash/pro are really good at new Godot 4 stuff. But as you mentioned it not the very latest Godot, so if you're using any latest features you would need to either add some skills for that or have web search enabled.
